notice: SYNTHETIC RECORDS. Made up by radar/triage/generate.py from a seed, to show what the radar would add where reports of a suspected breach of trade sanctions arrive. No report is or describes a real report, person or business; the parties are pseudonymous ids, and there are no names, addresses or contact details. A report is an allegation until a person has assessed it.
house_line: A rise in exports is a lead, not evidence of a breach.
